desc: Space Cadet Pinball was a game that shipped from Windows NT and the Windows 95 Plus back before it was suddenly removed without noticed from Windows Vista. For many years, there was nothing but speculation on why this beloved game was removed, until a post by Raymond Chen set the record straight.
